description: Source code for the 'Stock Status' controller in the admin area of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. Implements CRUD operations for stock status entries, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting stock statuses.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class managing stock status entries in the admin panel, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the stock status list page, setting up data and loading views.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX calls or direct requests to fetch and display the list of stock statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of stock statuses with pagination, sorting, and links to edit.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form to add or edit a stock status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions for creating or updating a stock status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected stock statuses if permitted and if no dependent products exist.
